na81c8eb0a9.summary: The Argentine peso dropped 5 pesos, closing at 62.176 per US dollar, with country risk rising above 1,900 basis points.
na81c8eb0a9.why: Currency depreciation and rising country risk indicate economic instability, affecting investment and debt costs in Argentina.
